verdict: Quiet break day. United are about to name Pochettino. Szoboszlai's knee is the worry.

posters.headline: Pochettino set for United job
posters.summary: The Athletic reports Pochettino will sign until 2029. Announcement could come as soon as Friday.

read.what: David Ornstein reports Mauricio Pochettino is set to become Manchester United manager on a two-and-a-half-year deal to summer 2029. He is expected to coach the USA over the international break, then arrive in time for the Liverpool match. Fabrizio Romano says terms were agreed on Wednesday. The announcement could come as soon as Friday.
read.context: Liverpool host United on Sunday 22 November. A new manager after a break can lift a side. He will also have had very little time with the squad.
read.take: Opinion: a new-manager bounce is real but short, and nine days is not much to change a system. Not official until United confirm it. Watch for the club statement and who he picks as staff.

posters.headline: Szoboszlai knee row grows
posters.summary: Hungary will decide late whether he plays. An ex-Hungary captain says Liverpool should have taken him off earlier.

read.what: Szoboszlai sprained his knee against Crystal Palace on 8 November, played on strapped and went off in the 69th minute. Hungary say the decision on him will come at the last minute. They play away at Georgia on Saturday 14 November and at home to Northern Ireland on Tuesday 17 November. Former Hungary captain Janos Csank said he should have come off at half-time. Iraola said he was fine but not 100%.
read.context: He is one of several doubts for United on 22 November, with Van Dijk and Gravenberch.
read.take: Opinion: the criticism of Iraola is one man's view and the sobbing claim is tabloid colour. The real question is whether Hungary risk him. Watch the squad news on Saturday.

nextMatch.teamNews: Van Dijk, Szoboszlai doubts; Gravenberch major doubt; Frimpong out. Sky lists 16:00 and 16:30.
